title: Preserve Announce reconciliation after post-commit peer admission failure
description: P1 correctness review: Node._process_announce removes the gradient when add_peer fails after AnnounceProcessor has durably committed the replay floor, but the processor has already cleared its one-shot equal-sequence reconciliation permit. A retry or restart can therefore reject the exact authenticated Announce while no route/peer state exists. Restore a bounded reconciliation permit on post-commit admission failure and cover retry behavior.
close_reason: Verified: restore is implemented at node.py:1296 (_restore_reconciliation_permit, validates seen/pinned then re-adds exactly one permit; set semantics bound it at 1/IID). Added python/tests/test_node.py test pinning restore after post-commit add_peer failure, boundedness across two failures, successful retry re-admission + permit consumption, and final equal-sequence fail-closed. 363 tests pass.
